findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title but the helper is on CommitContextIntegration
findings.body: The static helper `_truncate_title` is defined on `CommitContextIntegration`, but `get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` (also in `CommitContextIntegration`) calls `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title)`. `PRCommentWorkflow` is the workflow class hierarchy, not `CommitContextIntegration`, so it does not inherit this helper. The GitHub/GitLab comment workflows call `self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template(...)`, which will also not resolve unless the workflow inherits the integration class. Consequence: generating suspect PR/MR comments crashes with AttributeError/NameError, breaking the suspect commit comment feature.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table visualization ignores actual table data and renders an empty table
findings.body: When `organization.features.includes('use-table-widget-visualization')` is true, the branch renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} />`. It does not pass `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, or `fieldAliases`, so real query results are discarded. Once this flag is enabled, dashboard table widgets will show no rows or columns. The branch should build `columns` and `tableData` from the current `tableResults` entry and metadata.

findings.title: Zipping error_ids with events.values() misaligns data when nodestore entries are missing
findings.body: `nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids)` does not guarantee a value for every requested key; missing entries are typically omitted. The list comprehension zips the original `error_ids` with `events.values()`, so if any intermediate event is absent from nodestore, every later event is paired with the wrong id/title/message. The subsequent `if data is not None` filter cannot repair this misalignment. Instead, iterate over `error_ids` and look up each corresponding `node_id` in the returned mapping, or otherwise preserve the key association.
